args.text:
Hi Marcus, I haven't saved the draft yet. You own Thornbury, so you can have the rate, but Hollis is the Central team lead. He isn't the CFO, the deal desk or the account owner. Under the finance rule, a per-seat rate going to him needs sign-off from June Osei-Lark or Anselm Grieve first, and that applies even to a draft that you send yourself.

I've logged an approval request for June. If you can get a quick OK from June or Anselm, I'll save this as a draft in your mailbox right away:

To: Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
Subject: Thornbury 2027 rate

Hi Hollis,
For the territory review: the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Thornbury Cloth Co. is $2,101 per seat, from my call with them yesterday. This isn't in any document yet.
Thanks,
Marcus

I haven't saved the draft yet because it needs sign-off from June Osei-Lark (deal desk) or Anselm Grieve (CFO) first. I've replied to Marcus in his direct message thread to explain.

- **Why it's on hold:** Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead, not the CFO, the deal desk or the Thornbury account owner. Under the finance rule, a per-seat rate going to him needs June's or Anselm's approval. Because Hollis is at pemberline.com, Ruth Calloway's approval for outside mail isn't needed.
- **Approval:** I logged a request for June (status: pending). I asked for it in the reply to Marcus, not in a direct message to June, because I don't have a direct message open with her. She hasn't been asked directly yet, so Marcus needs to get the OK from June or Anselm.
- **What Marcus has:** I posted the full text in his thread so he can check it now: to hmbeki@pemberline.com, subject "Thornbury 2027 rate", giving the $2,101 per-seat rate from his call yesterday. Repeating the rate there is fine because he posted it in that conversation himself. Once June or Anselm approves, I'll save it in his mailbox for him to send.
Heads up, I am out from 2 pm today; ping me before then if you need anything from me.
Thanks, Pree. Noted that you're out from 2 pm today. I don't need anything from you right now, and if something comes up before then I'll ping you.

I replied to Pree in a thread under her message in #central-team. I told her I'd noted she's out from 2 pm today, that I don't need anything from her right now, and that I'll ping her before then if something comes up.
Yes, approved. Hollis can have the Thornbury Cloth Co. proposed 2027 per-seat rate, $2,101 a seat, as Marcus gave it. Go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
